pattern: SELECT [A-Z]+.\w+ FROM (TV_[A-Z]+) AS T[0-9] JOIN TV_[A-Z]+ AS T2 ON T[0-9].\d+ = T2.\w+ WHERE T[0-9].\w+ = '.*'
correction: Correct the table aliases consistency throughout the query and ensure the join condition is correct

metadata.description: This rule identifies errors where the table aliases are inconsistent or the join condition is incorrect
